اقتنعن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَنَعْنَ (iqtanaʕna) /iq.ta.naʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَنَعَ (iqtanaʕa)
# اِقْتَنِعْنَ (iqtaniʕna) /iq.ta.niʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَنَعَ (iqtanaʕa)
